name: 会议纪要
description: 把一场会的记录整理成纪要和待办：转录（人）→ 按发言人合并并保留起始时间 → 纪要（议题、要点、决定，每条决定标出处时间）→ 待办（一人、一事、日期、出处）→ 检查 → 会后邮件。 / Turn a meeting record into minutes and actions: transcript (person) → merge by speaker and keep each block's start time → minutes (topics, points, decisions, each decision cited to a time) → actions (one owner, one task, a date, a source time) → check → follow-up email.

meeting.description: 会议名称，例如：轻杯 Mini 产品周会 / Meeting name

date.description: 会议日期，YYYY-MM-DD / Meeting date, YYYY-MM-DD

attendees.description: 出席的人，可选。不填就从记录里的发言人写 / Who attended, optional. Leave empty to use the speakers in the transcript

style.description: 纪要体例：brief 简要，formal 正式 / Minutes style: brief or formal

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 转录
stages.description: 把会议记录放进 transcript/，可以是 .txt、.srt 或 .vtt。示例是一场虚构的 30 分钟产品周会，中英各一份 .srt。 / Put the record in transcript/ as .txt, .srt, or .vtt. The sample is a fictional 30-minute product weekly, one .srt in Chinese and one in English.

executor.instructions: 把你的记录放进 transcript/，扩展名用 .txt、.srt 或 .vtt。模板里有 weekly-zh.srt 和 weekly-en.srt，是虚构的南枝日用、轻杯 Mini 产品周会。文件名不带 zh 或 en 时，整理阶段只用你的文件；否则按 language 选用带 zh 或 en 的那一份。转录里常有姓名和发言，分享前先自己看一遍。 / Put your record in transcript/ as .txt, .srt, or .vtt. weekly-zh.srt and weekly-en.srt are a fictional Nanzhi Household weekly for Lightcup Mini. A file whose name has no zh or en tag is the one that gets cleaned; otherwise the file tagged for language is used. Transcripts often name people and what they said; read them yourself before you share.

stages.name: 整理
stages.description: 去掉字里的时间码，把同一人连续的发言并成一段，每段保留起始时间，例如 [12:30]。 / Strip timecodes from the words, merge consecutive lines from the same speaker, and keep each block's start, for example [12:30].

stages.name: 纪要
stages.description: 按议题写要点和决定。每条决定后面标整理稿里的起始时间，例如 [12:30]。 / Minutes by topic: points and decisions. Each decision is followed by its block start from the cleaned transcript, for example [12:30].

stages.name: 待办
stages.description: 每条待办一个负责人、一件具体的事、一个不早于会议的日期，以及整理稿里的出处时间。 / One owner, one concrete task, a date on or after the meeting, and a source time from the cleaned transcript.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 负责人是否出现在记录里、日期是否有效且不早于会议、出处时间是否存在、有没有重复。只提醒，不拦；actions.json 格式不对才停下。 / Whether each owner appears in the transcript, each due date is valid and not before the meeting, each source time exists, and nothing is duplicated. Warnings only, except a format error in actions.json, which stops the stage.

stages.name: 跟进邮件
stages.description: 一封可转发的会后邮件：决定和待办，不贴整份转录。 / A follow-up note people can forward: decisions and actions, not the raw transcript.
